resolution.question: Does neighbor Maria Santos notice the break-in at 42 Oak Street before the police arrive on August 20, 2026?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Maria Santos noticed the break-in (e.g., woke up, heard noise, saw something) before the police arrived at 42 Oak Street. Otherwise resolve NO at the time of police arrival or at the hard cutoff (2026-08-20T04:00:00-05:00), whichever comes first.
